title: Drunk Entitled Princess Kicks & Screams at Deputies After Ditch Crash!
description:
On May 11th, 2024, deputies in Ohio were called to a white Jeep that had driven into a ditch off the roadway and couldn’t drive out. Deputies approached the vehicle and talked to the female driver, who appeared to be intoxicated. The driver explained she had gotten stuck and needed help to get her car out. Upon further questioning, the driver told the deputy she had been to two parks and wanted to head home, later admitting to drinking beer earlier that night. 

After the deputy had identified the woman by her driver’s license, he asked her to exit her vehicle and walk towards the deputy’s car. The driver told the deputy she would be willing to perform Standardized Field Sobriety Tests (SFSTs). As the deputy conducted the SFSTs, the driver became increasingly agitated and began shouting back instructions, struggling to perform the tests. The situation escalated as the driver walked off from the deputies, stating she refused to continue the tests. Deputies placed the suspect under arrest for OVI as she began arguing and shouting at the deputies. 

As deputies walked the suspect toward the cruiser, she continued to shout and resist. The suspect attempted to open the cruiser door, lashing out as the deputies intervened. Deputies placed the suspect in the cruiser as she began kicking the interior of the vehicle. The suspect was later transported to jail for further processing. The suspect was charged with two counts of Felony Assault, Harassment with a Bodily Substance, OVI, Failure To Control, and Driving In Marked Lanes.
